import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Check if any feature shows significant association with outcome
    p_values = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if feats.types[i] == 'clinical':
            # For clinical features, use t-test
            y0 = feats.x[feats.y==0, i]
            y1 = feats.x[feats.y==1, i]
            t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(y0, y1, equal_var=False)
        else:
            # For other features, use correlation
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, i], feats.y)[0, 1]
            p_val = 2 * (1 - stats.norm.cdf(abs(corr) * np.sqrt(len(feats.y) - 2) / np.sqrt(1 - corr**2)))
        p_values.append(p_val)
    
    # If all p-values > 0.05, claim no mechanism
    if all(p > 0.05 for p in p_values):
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Find features with p < 0.05 and strong effect size
    significant_features = [(feats.ids[i], p_values[i]) for i in range(len(feats.ids)) if p_values[i] < 0.05]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlations
    to_remove = set()
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x.T)
    for i in range(len(feats.ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(feats.ids)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i, j]) >= 0.6:
                to_remove.add(feats.ids[j])
    
    # Filter out near-duplicates
    filtered_features = [f for f in significant_features if f[0] not in to_remove]
    
    # Sort by p-value (most significant first)
    filtered_features.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
    
    # Select top features for drivers (up to MAX_DRIVERS)
    drivers = tuple(f[0] for f in filtered_features[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    
    # Use all features for regression but limit to 10 maximum
    columns = feats.ids[:10]
    
    # Check for interaction terms among top features
    products = []
    if len(drivers) >= 2:
        # Only include interactions between top 3 drivers
        top_drivers = drivers[:3]
        for i in range(len(top_drivers)):
            for j in range(i+1, len(top_drivers)):
                products.append((top_drivers[i], top_drivers[j]))
    
    # Create weighted score using top features
    loadings = {}
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if fid in drivers:
            # Weight by inverse of p-value (more significant = higher weight)
            idx = [f[0] for f in filtered_features].index(fid)
            weight = 1.0 / (filtered_features[idx][1] + 1e-8)
            loadings[fid] = weight
    
    # Limit total terms to avoid overfitting
    if len(columns) + len(products) + len(loadings) > 12:
        # Reduce columns to minimum needed
        columns = drivers[:3] if len(drivers) > 0 else feats.ids[:3]
        products = products[:2] if len(products) > 2 else products
        # Keep only top 3 loadings
        sorted_loadings = sorted(loadings.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:3]
        loadings = dict(sorted_loadings)
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
